subject: Onramp sprintboard and evaluation gates — Aptarus pilot MAP
messages:
From: Lila Moreno <lila.moreno@aptarus.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aptarus: post-close MAP intake & SOW

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the leadership team reviewed and we have a green light to proceed with a limited pilot. Attached is the latest SOW and a short intake with our proposed milestones. A few asks from our side:

- We need a clear canary window definition (duration, traffic slice).
- Training plan for our ops + 1-day enablement for developers.
- Evaluation gates: latency and regression checks for the first 5K calls.

Can you confirm you can meet the target go-live window of mid-June? If helpful we can do a kickoff the week of 5/15.

Attachments: Aptarus_SOW_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Lila Moreno
Director, Platform Integrations
Aptarus Inc

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lila Moreno <lila.moreno@aptarus.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aptarus: post-close MAP intake & SOW

Hi Lila — great news, congrats on the green light.

We reviewed the SOW and sketched an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds the canary, migration, and training milestones into a sprintboard. High level:

1) Kickoff + commitments (week of 5/15) — confirm endpoints, network egress, and security questionnaire items.
2) Technical integration sprint (2 weeks) — SDK + auth integration, test harness.
3) Canary window (1 week) — 10% traffic slice, monitoring playbook, rollback criteria.
4) Evaluation gate (first 5K requests) — automated perf checks and quality sampling.
5) Gradual traffic ramp and training (2 weeks) — ops runbook and train-the-trainer sessions.

I uploaded a draft MAP spreadsheet with milestones and owners: [Attachment: Draft_MAP_Aptarus.xlsx]. I'll propose concrete dates in the kickoff, but mid-June go-live looks feasible if we start next week.

Next steps:
- Can we lock kickoff for 5/16 at 11am PT?
- Marissa, can you own the training curriculum and the evaluation rubric?
- Lila, please confirm who from Aptarus IT will be on the kickoff (and whether they need VPN/VPC peering).

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Lila Moreno <lila.moreno@aptarus.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aptarus: post-close MAP intake & SOW

Adding technical notes ahead of kickoff:

- Canary slice: recommend 1% -> 5% -> 10% over three days for production traffic if latency SLOs hold. Use traffic steering by route to isolate pilot services.
- Monitoring: we'll wire up token-level latency and error-rate dashboards; suggest an SLO of p95 < 180ms for the pilot workload.
- Caching: enable prefix KV caching for common prompts to reduce token cost during the canary.
- Rollback criteria: any sustained p95 > 300ms for >30m OR error rate >1% triggers automated rollback.

I'll prepare a short technical annex for the MAP that includes the canary runbook and the script for automated rollbacks. Attaching an initial CSV schedule: [Attachment: Canary_Schedule_v1.csv].

Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Lila Moreno <lila.moreno@aptarus.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, it@aptarus.com
Date: 2028-05-14T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aptarus: post-close MAP intake & SOW

Thanks — 5/16 11am PT works for us. I'll bring our Head of Engineering (same mailbox copied) and 1-2 SREs. A couple clarifications before kickoff:

- For the evaluation gate, do you run both automated perf checks and a manual quality sample? We want both.
- Training: can you split the 2-week training into a 1-day developer workshop + two 1-hour ops sessions?

Also confirming mid-June go-live is the target. Please include the HubSpot deal link in the wrap-up so our procurement team can reference the deal id.

Best,
Lila

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Subject: MAP: Onramp sprintboard and evaluation gates — Aptarus pilot

Lila — thanks for the confirmations and for lining up your SREs. Recap and final commitments from our side before kickoff on 5/16:

- Kickoff: 2028-05-16 11:00 AM PT (Zoom) — agenda will include security checklist, traffic definitions, and training plan. Zoom invite + calendar will follow.
- MAP draft: owners assigned in the attached spreadsheet (Stephanie = overall cadence, Marissa = training & evaluation rubric, Karthik = tech annex and canary runbook).
- Canary plan: recommended ramp (1% / 5% / 10%) with rollback triggers as Karthik outlined.
- Evaluation: automated perf checks (p50/p95/p99) + manual sampling of 200 responses across the first 5K calls; quality regression alert if >5% sample fails rubric.
- Docs: HubSpot deal link below for procurement and a placeholder DocuSign envelope will be sent after kickoff.
